description: Use when a pod or workload is unhealthy in Kubernetes: pods stuck in Pending, CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull, containers OOMKilled (exit code 137), failing liveness, readiness or startup probes, pods Running but not Ready, a Deployment rollout that does not progress (ProgressDeadlineExceeded), or a Job or CronJob that fails. Investigates with kubectl get, describe, logs and events, and proposes fixes. Reads first and asks before changing anything.
